title: Temporary Rate Reduction Plan: Rate Points for Loan Age
content:
## The rule

For a Temporary Rate Reduction Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan funded at least 24 whole calendar months before the request date takes 0.50 percentage points off the plan rate; a loan funded at least 12 but fewer than 24 whole calendar months before it takes 0.25 points off; a younger loan takes none, a month counting as complete only when the later date reaches the funding day of the month. The funding date is the one on the loan's Personal Loans record.

| Whole calendar months from funding to the request date | Points off the plan rate |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 0.50 |
| 12 to 23 | 0.25 |
| fewer than 12 | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Funded 9 October; request on 8 October two years later: 23 whole months, 0.25. On 9 October two years later: 24 months, 0.50.
- Funded 9 October; request on 8 October of the next year: 11 months, none. On 9 October of the next year: 12 months, 0.25.
